csm_karen: Harper Labs go-live is scheduled for next Tue. We need a final ramp schedule + autoscale thresholds + quota priming plan. Can we lock windows today? :calendar:
eng_raj: I can take autoscale thresholds. What's their expected peak RPS and acceptable p95 latency?
ops_mel: Reserved pool is 6 GPUs (a100-80). Current warm pool scripts take ~8min to prime all 6. We should avoid >30s cold-starts for critical routes.
devex_ted: For load tests, recommend headless Locust run. Example we used for Nova:
```
locust -f tests/harper_locust.py --headless -u 1200 -r 80 --run-time 20m --host https://api.redwood.internal
```
use `-u` to match their target concurrent users.
csm_karen: Perfect. Harper Ops wants a low-risk dry-run first (no ingress from prod). Proposed windows: dry-run Wed 02:00-04:00 UTC, smoke Thu 20:00-22:00 UTC, go-live Tue 18:00 UTC. Thoughts?
eng_raj: Wed dry-run OK for infra. For autoscale, propose:
```
min_replicas: 2
scale_cpu_target: 60
scale_rps_target: 700
cooldown: 90s
fallback_model: small-quantized-v1
```
if RPS>1200 for 90s, trigger burst pool.
ops_mel: I'll pre-create the burst pool and KMS keys. Also adding a prefix-KV cache priming step: run 5 synthetic requests per key shard to fill KV. Example curl: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/prime -d '{"prompt":"seed"}'`
devex_ted: Add a canary route pointing to the new pool and a traffic-shift playbook. Sequence: 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% over 15m with rollback on p95 > 800ms or error rate > 1%. I'll drop the playbook link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/dedicated-commissioning
csm_karen: @eng_raj @ops_mel please confirm you can join Wed 01:30 UTC for a 30m pre-check (accounts, quotas, flow). I'll invite Harper Ops then.
eng_raj: Confirmed. I'll push a canary config and a short smoke script.
ops_mel: Confirmed. I'll run the pool priming and share logs in this thread.
oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window conflict detected on Wed 02:15 UTC in us-west-2. See https://status.redwood.internal/maintenance/3421
csm_karen: Good catch — Ops, can you slide dry-run to 03:00-05:00 UTC or we risk overlapping?
ops_mel: I can move to 03:00-05:00. Updating the runbook.
devex_ted: One more note: include a token-usage cap during dry-run to avoid bill surprises. Add header `X-Test-Mode: true` on synthetic traffic.
csm_karen: Great — final checklist for today: (1) eng_raj posts autoscale JSON in infra repo, (2) ops_mel provisions burst pool & KMS, (3) devex_ted posts locust job and canary playbook link, (4) I send invite to Harper Ops for Wed 02:30 UTC (now 03:30). We'll reconvene here after pre-check. :thumbsup:
eng_raj: will do — posting autoscale PR in ~30m.
ops_mel: provisioning started, ETA 45m. I'll paste logs when done.
devex_ted: locust script uploaded to ci/test-jobs/harper, canary playbook updated.
csm_karen: thank you everyone — keeping this thread as our single source of truth.
